直接从未解压的文件夹导入嘉立创EDA专业版工程（.epro2）与库（.elibz: Import EasyEDA Pro projects (.epro2) and libraries (.elibz2) straight from unzipped folders. The extension walks the folder tree, recognises nested project/library folders, re-packs them in memory and imports them through the official import pipeline - nothing is written to disk, so clients whose local file-encryption (DLP) agent blocks archive import can still load their designs.
